lead.headline: McLaurin's season is over — claim Metcalf before 01:00
lead.deck: Tuesday's MRI confirmed season-ending surgery; the bye swaps are made and the lineup is the projection lineup.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Terry McLaurin's MRI came back this afternoon: season-ending knee surgery. Chem has no IR slot, so he is a dead roster spot, and the one move left before waivers process at 01:00 is the claim this morning's brief proposed — DK Metcalf, Pittsburgh's WR1, for McLaurin. Priority resets weekly, so it costs nothing lasting. The three bye swaps landed: Love, Gordon and Jefferson are in, the lineup projects 129.5 against JuiceJam's 90.2, and ESPN makes AVIATO a 71% favourite.

cards.headline: Claim DK Metcalf, drop McLaurin — before 01:00
